
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
```

```{r}
leases <- read_csv("Leases_WithDates_FixedNA.csv")
```

```{r}
summary(leases)
```

```{r}
occupancy <- read.csv("MajorMarketOccupancyData-revised.csv")
corp_rates <- read.csv("CorpRates.csv")
qual <- read.csv("High_Qual_Percentage.csv")
```

```{r}
names(corp_rates) <- tolower(names(corp_rates))
names(qual) <- tolower(names(qual))

corp_rates$state <- state.abb[match(corp_rates$state, state.name)]
```

```{r}
leases <- leases %>%
  mutate(market = ifelse(market == "Chicago Suburbs", "Chicago", market))
```

```{r}
# join data
data <- inner_join(leases, corp_rates, by = c("year" = "year", "state" = "state"))
#data <- inner_join(data, occupancy, by = c("market" = "market", "year" = "year", "quarter" = "quarter"))
data <- inner_join(data, qual, by= c("year"="year", "quarter"="quarter", "market"="market"))

unique(data$market)
```


```{r}
# Check duplicates in the leases dataframe
duplicates_leases <- leases %>%
  group_by(year, quarter, market) %>%
  filter(n() > 1)

# Check duplicates in the occupancy dataframe
duplicates_occupancy <- occupancy %>%
  group_by(year, quarter, market) %>%
  filter(n() > 1)

print(duplicates_leases)
print(duplicates_occupancy)
```

```{r}
nrow(data)
```

```{r}
dummies <- dummyVars(~ internal_industry, data = data)
encoded <- predict(dummies, newdata = data)
data <- cbind(data, encoded)

# Make column names unique
#colnames(data) <- make.unique(colnames(data))
```

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(rates = as.numeric(gsub("%", "", rates)) / 100)
```

```{r}
sapply(data[, c(
  #"ending_occupancy_proportion",
 # "starting_occupancy_proportion",
  #"avg_occupancy_proportion",
  "overall_rent",
  "rates",
  "high_qual_percentage"
)], class)
```

```{r}
market_quarter_summary <- data %>%
  group_by(market, year, quarter) %>%
  summarise(
    overall_rent = mean(overall_rent, na.rm = TRUE),
    rates = mean(rates, na.rm = TRUE),
    high_qual_percentage = mean(high_qual_percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
market_quarter_scaled <- market_quarter_summary %>%
  select(overall_rent, rates, high_qual_percentage) %>%
  scale() %>%
  as_tibble()

# Step 3: Run K-means clustering
km_mq <- kmeans(market_quarter_scaled, centers = 4, nstart = 10)

# Step 4: Add cluster labels back to the summary data
market_quarter_clusters <- market_quarter_summary %>%
  mutate(cluster = km_mq$cluster)

# View result
colnames(km_mq$centers)
```

```{r}
library(cluster)

# Calculate silhouette scores for a range of cluster numbers
sil_width <- sapply(2:10, function(k) {
  km <- kmeans(market_quarter_scaled, centers = k, nstart = 10)
  sil <- silhouette(km$cluster, dist(market_quarter_scaled))
  mean(sil[, 3])
})

# Plot silhouette scores
ggplot(data.frame(k = 2:10, silhouette_score = sil_width), aes(x = k, y = silhouette_score)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Silhouette Method for Optimal Clusters", x = "Number of Clusters", y = "Average Silhouette Score") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Calculate the within-cluster sum of squares (WSS) for a range of cluster numbers
wss <- sapply(1:10, function(k) {
  kmeans(market_quarter_scaled, centers = k, nstart = 10)$tot.withinss
})

# Create a plot
ggplot(data.frame(k = 1:10, wss = wss), aes(x = k, y = wss)) +
  geom_line() + 
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Elbow Method for Optimal Clusters", x = "Number of Clusters", y = "Within-Cluster Sum of Squares") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
ggplot(pivot_longer(as_tibble(km_mq$centers,  rownames = "cluster"), 
  cols = colnames(km_mq$centers)), 
  aes(y = name, x = value, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(cluster)) +
  labs(y = "feature", x = "z-scores", title = "Cluster Profiles") + 
  guides(fill="none")
```


```{r}
# Box plot of overall_rent for each cluster
ggplot(market_quarter_clusters, aes(x = factor(cluster), y = overall_rent, fill = factor(cluster))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Box Plot of Overall Rent by Cluster",
       x = "Cluster",
       y = "Overall Rent") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7")) +  # Optional: Customize labels for clusters
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")  # Remove legend for clarity
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Create a new variable combining year and quarter
market_quarter_clusters <- market_quarter_clusters %>%
  mutate(year_quarter = paste(year, quarter, sep = "-"))

# Ensure 'year_quarter' is ordered correctly
market_quarter_clusters <- market_quarter_clusters %>%
  mutate(year_quarter = factor(year_quarter, levels = unique(year_quarter)))

# Plot with the combined 'year_quarter' variable and no x-axis label
ggplot(market_quarter_clusters, aes(x = year_quarter, y = cluster)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = market)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ market) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:7) +  # Adjust cluster range if necessary
  labs(title = "Cluster Assignments Over Time by Market", y = "Cluster", x = "Quarter and Year") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) 

```

```{r}
print(market_quarter_clusters)
```
